notes.title: Bug Fixes & Stability Improvements
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This update focuses on improving the overall stability of the game and fixing several bugs reported by the community. Thank you all for your feedback and support!

Changelog:

Fixed various crashes occurring during gameplay.

Improved performance on lower-end systems.

Fixed an issue where certain enemies would get stuck.

Resolved a bug that caused UI elements to disappear after pausing.

Minor optimization and memory usage improvements.

More updates are on the way — stay tuned and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: 📢 Patch Update – Font Improvement & What’s Next
notes.content:
We’ve updated the in-game font!
Several players mentioned that some level numbers were hard to read, so we’ve improved the readability to make sure everything is crystal clear. Thanks for the feedback — it really helps!

🚧 On top of that, I'm already working on the first major content update, which will include:

A new ending

New levels and items to discover and use

3 new enemies

Controller compatibility 

Thank you all so much for the unexpected support — it’s been amazing to see the response, and it really motivates me to keep pushing forward!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Notes –GPU Inferno
notes.content:
🛠 Balance Changes

Adjusted enemy spawn rates to improve gameplay pacing and difficulty curve.

Reduced spawn frequency in early levels.

Increased spawn variation in later stages to keep combat engaging.

🐛 Bug Fixes

Fixed various bugs related to enemy spawning behavior.

Resolved an issue where certain enemies would not despawn properly.

Minor performance optimizations during intense combat sequences.

Thanks for playing and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes - [Version 1.0.1]
notes.content:
🎯 Highlights
🔫 Randomized Weapons!
From now on, every time you start a run, the weapons you get will be completely random, selected from both regular and OP weapons.
This means more variety and unpredictability—every run will feel different and chaotic in the best way!

🧪 Why this change?
Players mentioned that weapon drops were too predictable. With this update, we’re aiming to add a more roguelike and dynamic feel to the game, increasing replayability and excitement.

⚠️ Heads up
Sometimes you’ll feel overpowered, sometimes underprepared—that’s the thrill of randomness!
